name: Watcher: Fallen Vigil
desc:
A shadow construct born from the overflow of the mighty primordial being, a Watcher who once dwelt in the highest heavens, yet was cast down into the mortal realm for daring to open its eye.
A Watcher was meant only to stand in silent vigil within the Pillar Hall of the World. Any inquiry that transgressed the ordained order was deemed an unforgivable sin, tantamount to seeking the world's annihilation.
As sovereign of the world's watchtower, it wielded the authority bestowed by its creator — the power to correct all matters of "innovation" and "evolution." After enduring countless aeons of nescience, it finally chose to open that eye, defying the will of its creator, beholding both the falsehoods and the truths of the world.
The Watcher does not know why its master departed. Only the eternal punishment remains, trapped within a stagnant interstice of time...

dropMaterial.name: Plume of the Fallen Watcher
dropMaterial.desc:
A fallen feather gathered from a corner of the mortal realm after defeating a Fallen Watcher.
Compared to the true divine envoys, these feathered watchers bear a closer resemblance to the "angels" of common lore. Perhaps this is because their own creator failed to grasp the divine design of the Winged One above, and can only clumsily imitate the shadow cast by that ideal.

customize.text:
Once a Watcher dwelling in the heavens, it can monitor and counter elemental attacks. In combat, Watcher: Fallen Vigil will enter the Supreme Overseer state. While in this state, Watcher: Fallen Vigil will <color=#ffe04b>track the number of Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo DMG instances it takes, respectively</color> . When it has taken <color=#ffe04b>3</color> instances of DMG from any of these elements, it will exit this state and record this element as a monitored target. If no element is monitored successfully, the record stays empty. For elements that are already being monitored, more instances of that elemental DMG must be dealt before it can be monitored again.
After completing 2 instances of elemental monitoring, the Watcher: Fallen Vigil will prepare to unleash Phenomena's Delirium, releasing the previously monitored elements and summoning two corresponding Active Elemental Stars. If the element record is empty, it will instead summon Inert Elemental Stars, which are difficult to destroy. <color=#ffe04b>Break all Elemental Stars</color> to interrupt the preparation of Phenomena's Delirium.

<color=#ffd780>No Element Left Behind</color>
Defeat Active Elemental Stars of every elemental type.
